Tout ce qui se règle pour mieux jouer: Everything you can set to play better
Chaque réglage a un effet vérifiable et: Every setting has a verifiable effect and undoes exactly: the original value is kept. “Boosts” with no measured effect (TCP networking, HPET, timer, services turned off, “Ultimate Performance” plan) are not here.
« Tout optimiser » applique les réglages: “Optimize everything” applies the performance settings; a single administrator permission for those that need it.
Ce qu'aucun réglage ne corrige d'ici, ma: What no setting fixes from here, but costs the most in games.
Ce qui fait gagner des images ou de la l: What gains frames or latency, measured or documented by Microsoft, NVIDIA and AMD. The counter at the top only counts these.
Pratique en jeu, sans gain d'images : c': Handy in games, no frame gain: said as it is.
Le « Game Boost » des boosters arrête de: Boosters' “Game Boost” closes programs to free memory: Windows Game Mode already does it, cleanly, every game. To see what really uses resources: Performance.
Visual C++, DirectX 9, XNA, OpenAL, Phys: Visual C++, DirectX 9, XNA, OpenAL, PhysX: a game that will not start (“MSVCP140.dll not found”, “d3dx9_43.dll missing”…) is often missing one of them. Installed through winget, from the official sources.
Les réglages que les communautés recomma: The settings communities recommend, for the Steam games installed on this PC. The added cfg can be removed in one click, your own lines stay.
Observe le PC pendant 10 secondes et cla: Watches the PC for 10 seconds and ranks the apps by what they use. Run it when the PC is slow. To act: Startup (what launches by itself) or Uninstall.
Lancez une analyse pour voir ce qui cons: Run an analysis to see what uses resources.
Décochez ce qui n'a pas besoin de démarr: Untick what does not need to start with Windows: it can be undone, and Task Manager sees the same setting. “Measure their impact” reads the times Windows itself measured during the last boots.
Les entrées « Tous les utilisateurs », e: “All users” entries, and sometimes the measurement, need administrator permission.
Durée des derniers démarrages, en second: Duration of the last boots, in seconds
Les réglages de confidentialité les plus: The most followed privacy settings (those of Chris Titus's WinUtil, among others), without the ones that break something. They do not make the PC faster: they limit what Windows collects, suggests and shows. Each one undoes exactly.
Ce que des « optimiseurs » et des guides: What “optimizers” and guides may have left on this PC that slows it down or exposes it. Each point relies on Microsoft's documentation or on published measurements; “Restore” puts Windows' value back and keeps the old one, to go back.
Les points en bleu sont seulement signal: Points in blue are only reported: no proven harm, or a defensible choice.
Ce que Sécurité Windows surveille déjà :: What Windows Security already watches: antivirus on and up to date, firewall on, Windows updates waiting. No “score”: facts, and where to act.
L'application en crée un avant chaque in: The app creates one before every driver installation. Create one yourself before trying a risky setting; “Restore the system” brings Windows back to the chosen date, without touching your documents.
Windows demandera l'autorisation adminis: Windows will ask for administrator permission to read the list and create a point.
« Afficher » lit la liste des points que: “Show” reads the list of points Windows keeps.
État rapporté par Windows. « Avertisseme: Status reported by Windows. “Warning” or “Failing”, or wear close to 100 %: back up your data without waiting. Wear, temperature and battery need administrator permission.
Capacité restante comparée à une batteri: Capacity left compared with a new battery. Under 80 %, battery life drops clearly; under 60 %, consider replacing it.
Ce qui libère vraiment de la place, sans: What really frees space, without breaking anything: temporary files, old versions of Windows components, the hibernation file. No “registry cleaning”: it gains nothing and is the first cause of breakage.
Fichiers de plus de 2 jours dans votre d: Files older than 2 days in your temporary folder. Files in use are left in place. Windows' temporary folder (C:\Windows\Temp) needs administrator permission.
Windows garde les anciennes versions de: Windows keeps the old versions of its components after every update. Microsoft's cleanup (DISM) deletes them and often frees several GB; updates already installed can then no longer be uninstalled. Allow 10 to 30 minutes.
Les outils de Microsoft. SFC vérifie et: Microsoft's tools. SFC checks and repairs system files; DISM repairs the Windows image SFC relies on: run it first if SFC does not succeed. Allow 10 to 30 minutes.
Le résumé de la vérification apparaîtra: The check's summary will appear here.
Via winget, le gestionnaire de logiciels: Through winget, the software manager built into Windows. Up-to-date software means fewer security holes. Windows may ask for permission for some of them.
Lancez une recherche pour voir les logic: Run a search to see the software to update.
Désinstaller lance le désinstalleur du p: Uninstall starts the program's uninstaller. Then “Find leftovers” offers the folders it left behind; they go to the Recycle Bin, so nothing is lost. The registry is not “cleaned”: it gains nothing and is the number one cause of breakage.
Cochés d'office : le dossier d'installat: Ticked by default: the declared install folder. The others only share the same name: check before ticking. Program Files and ProgramData folders: administrator permission.
Vos choix, gardés d'une fois sur l'autre: Your choices, kept from one time to the next.
Chaque mercredi, l'application cherche e: Every Wednesday, the app looks quietly, without administrator rights, and only tells you when there is something new.
Vérifier chaque semaine les pilotes de W: Check Windows Update drivers every week and tell me
Souvent la même version : le Studio est: Often the same version: Studio is tested longer with creative apps. For gaming, Game Ready.
Game Ready : pour jouer, prêt le jour de: Game Ready: for gaming, ready on the day of big releases
Prend effet au prochain démarrage de l'a: Takes effect at the app's next start.
